package service

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type StudentService interface {
	GetPlanningProfile(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningProfile, error)
	QueryMastery(context.Context, string, []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error)
	AssignCourse(context.Context, string, string, string, string) error
	CreateLearningPath(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningPathReplacement) (domain.LearningPathAllocation, error)
	GetLearningPathPlanningState(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error)
	ReplanLearningPath(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningPathReplan) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error)
	CompleteLearningPath(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningPathCompletion) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error)
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentStudentService is deliberately narrower than Student's
// learner/progress ports: reservation and aggregate result only.
type DiagnosticAssessmentStudentService interface {
	ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation, error)
	GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, error)
}

// PracticeStudentMasteryService is the narrow student-owned evidence boundary
// required to freeze a task-specific learning route.
type PracticeStudentMasteryService interface {
	QueryMastery(context.Context, string, []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error)
}

// StudentPlanningReadinessService is the read-only Student boundary used by
// graph readiness. It exposes neither onboarding writes nor path commands.
type StudentPlanningReadinessService interface {
	GetPlanningReadiness(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error)
}
